results.title: Unfading
results.overview: This visually evocative drama, directed by the legendary Marlen Khutsiev and completed after his death, is inspired by the real-life encounters between Anton Chekhov and Leo Tolstoy. Through a series of intimate conversations, the two literary giants confront the fundamental questions of existence—life, death, faith, and immortality. In doing so, they reveal profoundly different worldviews, yet ones rooted in a shared cultural tradition and bound by mutual respect.  In 2026, the film was finished at the initiative of Marlen Khutsiev’s friends and colleagues.

results.title: SHIRT!
results.overview: SHIRT! is a dark comedy that explores the notion of nature vs. nurture through the eyes of an adult only child who receives a surprising gift on Christmas morning.

results.title: Desperately Need A Plan
results.overview: A young man accidentally kills an elderly woman. Terrified of the consequences, he hides the body in his apartment. After two days, he finally decides to reveal his horrible secret to his best friend. But how can he be sure that confessing is the right choice? Is it the reaction of the person standing before him that frightens Eliot, or simply his own imagination?

results.title: Ghoulmaster
results.overview: Late-night TV once belonged to horror hosts, and none were more infamous than a local legend known as The Ghoulmaster. When his final broadcast resurfaces on VHS, the host returns with it, and the viewers become his unwilling cast.

results.title: Nedo, un italiano
results.overview: Born in Florence in 1925, Nedo Fiano survived Auschwitz after being forced to work in the Kanada Kommando, sorting the belongings of deportees arriving at the camp. Through his testimony and the memories of his children and grandchildren, the film retraces his arrest, deportation, the loss of his entire family at Auschwitz-Birkenau, and the “death march” that took him through seven other camps. It also explores how the trauma of the Holocaust was passed down through generations, through silence, memory, and painful stories.

results.title: I Giorni Della Settimana Sono Dispari
results.original_title: I Giorni Della Settimana Sono Dispari
results.overview: Daniele has built a tailor-made life: silent, empty, controlled. But when his only glass shatters on the floor, that perfect balance collapses. Driven by a sudden impulse, he sets off toward the mountains in search of answers. But he is not alone: in his trunk, an unpleasant surprise awaits him.

results.title: Maternal Dreams
results.overview: Once I had a prophetic dream about a miscarriage. The idea for the film grew out of that dream. Dreams of pregnancy and childbirth, with rare exceptions, come only to women — whether they have children or not. Through 2025, women anonymously sent in their dreams of motherhood via Google Forms. Some of those dreams became the basis for my film.

results.title: Iron Fisted Tyrant 2
results.overview: James Wylie's 2025 conclusion to the Time franchise, 'Saving Time', was a feature length motion picture released to critical acclaim.  But just what do the people behind the picture have to say about it? 'Iron Fisted Tyrant 2' is a documentary that asks the audience questions about power and control in the arts, the nature of adversarial relationships, and the strength of reconciliation.

results.title: but days pass like this
results.overview: A duet for two eyes, just one at a time. Shot on a 1952 Stereo Realist and on a consumer 3D video camera made 70 years later. Hand processed, each eye numbered, taken apart and rebuilt a frame at a time. Made by hand. Sung at a distance. “The Happy Sunny Side of Life” (1936) counter melodies against despair.
